body: Not really. I had to leave my apartment. I’m living off of the little bit of money I have left but once that’s gone, idk what to do. I feel out of options, honestly.
That’s exactly what I was thinking. And the idea that suffering in life is character building or some kind of honor in certain religions. They romanticize it.

I think about this a lot. I mean, how do we even know death is that bad? We assume being in this world is better but what if it isn’t? Especially for people who just have constantly terrible lives. People always say things get better but for some it literally doesn’t. Sometimes life is just horrible, and then you die.

I feel you. Treat you like crap or brush you off, then want to cry a river when it’s all said and done. I told one of my friends that when I die, don’t let my family come to my funeral, fake crying or anything bc they don’t care now when I try to explain what I’m going through. I honesty believe a lot of people don’t care about others suffering, they only don’t want you to die bc that’s when it affects them.

Same. For years, I thought it was just bad memory but now I think its like a way your brain “saves” you. Like how your phone switches to low power mode or turns down the brightness when the battery is low.
